newsitem.title: UK: Cap & Regional strengthens retail portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Cap & Regional strengthens retail portfolio.

text.p: Britain's Capital and Regional Properties Plc announced a 147 million pound acquisition on Friday which would pitchfork it to one of the top leading retail property companies in the country.
Capital and Regional said it had contracted to buy five in-town shopping centres across the UK and the deals would boost its gross property assets from 248 million stg 395 million stg.
"It is consistent with the current retail sector growth," chairman Martin Barber told Reuters.
Capital alrady owns and manages four in-town shopping centres and seven out-of-town retail warehouse parks.
"This is our single largest transaction to date and one which will significantly increase both the scale and visibility of the company," he said.
Capital is well known for adding value to property rented out, aimed at boosting inflow of customers into retail centres.
The firm uses innovative crowd-pulling tactics including fashion shows, famous personality lookalikes and celebrity autograph signing sessions.
The five properties which it plans to buy from Grosvenor Asset Managment will yield an initial rent of 10 million stg a year, rising to 13 million pounds.
The company will also continue to pursue its disposal programme in oder to regenerate equity.
"We have already raised 12.5 million pounds this year," Barber said. "We are weeding out some of our office property," he said.
The acquisitions will push the share of retail property in its portfolio to close to 90 percent, Barber said.
The company plans to improve tenant mix and develop additional space in some its retail proepties as well as explore the provision of leisure and catering facilities.
The acquisitions will be partly financed by a rights issue of three for five shares held which will yield 60.5 million stg, while the balance will be funded by banking facilties.
Barber said the company's gearing was close to 120 percent, which was comfortable for the company. -- Arindam Nag, London Newsroom +44 171 542 4366
